input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services:
input.rationale: The only renewal mechanic is the maintenance term in Section 10 (p0065): a "renewable one-year term" of maintenance. There is no automatic renewal language anywhere in the Agreement (a full-text search for "renew" returns only p0065), so no non-renewal notice window is imposed on Sparkling and there is no automatic multi-year renewal or walk-away trap. The Agreement also contains no renewal price-uplift mechanic — maintenance fees are fixed by reference to the Fee Schedule and Section 10 states maintenance is provided "without additional fees or charges" — so no uncapped increase is authorised. Both fallback elements are conditional on automatic renewal / permitted price increases and are therefore satisfied on the material terms; the renewal term is in any event one year, not multi-year. The surrounding term structure favours us: the licence is perpetual so long as fees are paid (p0117) and Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice (p0118). Noted short of preferred wording only: the clause does not expressly say renewal is by mutual written agreement, and there is no express CPI/3% cap on any future renewal-period maintenance fee quoted in Schedule "A" (the Schedule is not attached). These are minor sub-elements, not deviations, so we do not redline.
